Trust Tier Definition MatrixLink

Trust TierResponse PatternRelease PostureGrowth or Sourcing PostureFounder Expectation
InstitutionalClean acknowledgments, low reminder burden, and predictable follow-through on critical matters.Normal controlled release within standard UNYRA gates.Growth and sourcing can scale without extra trust friction premium.Review monthly and protect the standard.
ControlledMostly responsive, but timing still needs active management on key matters.Release allowed with explicit deadline control and short revalidation windows.Growth or sourcing can continue, but only with visible watch points.Review every cycle until reliability is stronger.
FragileRepeated reminders, stage-2 escalation, or silence on release-critical matters.Tighten release, require dated confirmation, and hold acceleration until behavior improves.Slow account growth or activate backup sourcing until two cleaner cycles appear.Founder should treat trust as a real operating constraint.
RestrictedSilence, broken commitments, or unresolved risk now undermine safe release confidence.Hold, revalidate, or founder-approve only under exceptional logic.Stop scaling, open fallback path, and protect continuity first.Immediate founder intervention and short review cadence.
